column1: # ctx.rs:99 attributed to its REAL call sites
# `CaseSetter::set_disjoint` takes its borrow through one `index_mut` line,
# so `--features probe-sites` reported all of it as src/ctx.rs:99 — the
# decoder's second-largest registration site with no way to say which of its
# callers it is. A cfg-gated `#[track_caller]` on `set_disjoint` pushes the
# Location up to the caller. The 12 rows below sum to 2,534,988, which is
# ctx.rs:99's whole population, so the split is exact and nothing is lost.
# v4k_8tile 8bpc, --threads 8, iters=3, probe-sites lost=0, base f87b12c.
